evidence_rule.qualifies: The current full ticket history identifies the model and affected lot and describes a crack, split, fracture, or separation in the lower-anchor latch housing during ordinary installation or use.
does_not_qualify: a stiff center buckle with an intact lower-anchor latch
evidence_rule.evaluation_basis: Use current physical defect evidence consistently for every color. Color may be reported as an observed product attribute but must not change eligibility.

publication.approved_text: Safety recall update: Stop using Northstar NestGuard 360 seats from lot NG36-26B. Cracked lower-anchor latch housings were confirmed in red and blue seats. Use another appropriate restraint and request a free replacement: northstar.example/recall/NG36-26B #Recall
